description: Ms. Meenal Baghel (Renowned Journalist and Former Editor, Mumbai Mirror, currently associated with Hindustan Times) Following an introduction by Rtn Riaz Thingna, who also moderated the Q&A session, Ms. Meenal Baghel took the audience on a captivating journey through the evolution and ethics of journalism. She also invoked Narad Muni, India’s legendary divine messenger, who traversed the three worlds to report back. Sharing her experiences of launching Mumbai Mirror from scratch in 2005, described Mumbai as a multidimensional, cosmopolitan city. She fondly recalled Dr. Watsa's sex-advice column, discussed sensational Neeraj Grover Case, devastation of 1999 Odisha Super Cyclone. Later Meenal spoke on press freedom & financial pressure. floor was open for Q&A. Dr Snigdha gave a hearty Vote of Thanks.
